usedFor: Shopify holds orders, and Burq runs deliveries, so “Order Cancelled” can stop one with “Cancel delivery”.

bestTemplate.name: “Order Cancelled” in Shopify, then “Cancel delivery” in Burq
bestTemplate.why: A cancelled order should not reach a courier, so the action stops that delivery.

watchOut: “Cancel delivery” stops a delivery from being fulfilled, so the cancelled order must match the right delivery.
